water_bottle.name: Water bottle
water_bottle.desc: Half a litre in a plastic bottle gone milky in the sun. Three good swallows.

canteen.name: Steel canteen
canteen.desc: A litre in dented steel under a felt cover. Keeps it cooler than plastic does.

water_can.name: Water can
water_can.desc: Ten litres in a blue plastic can. A week for one careful person. Heavy as sin.

beans_tin.name: Tin of beans
beans_tin.desc: Beans in sauce, label long gone. Keeps forever. You need a blade or an opener to get in.

peaches_tin.name: Tin of peaches
peaches_tin.desc: Peaches in syrup. Drink the syrup; out here nobody wastes it.

jerky.name: Jerky
jerky.desc: A strip of dried meat. What kind of meat is a question you stop asking. Salty: it costs you water.

dried_meat.name: Dried meat
dried_meat.desc: A slab of smoke-dried meat wrapped in paper. A dog will follow you a mile for it. So will people.

coffee.name: Trail coffee
coffee.desc: Ground coffee in a twist of foil, boiled black in a can. It buys you an hour on your feet.

rotgut.name: Rotgut
rotgut.desc: Clear liquor from a still behind somebody's garage. Steadies the hands, then doesn't.

flatbread.name: Flatbread
flatbread.desc: Baked on a steel plate in Rust Haven this week. Eat it before it turns.

cactus_fruit.name: Cactus fruit
cactus_fruit.desc: Red pear off a paddle cactus, spines rubbed off in the sand. Wet and sweet.

ration.name: Ration pack
ration.desc: A sealed meal in olive foil, stamped with a date from before the split. Still good. Probably.

honey.name: Jar of honey
honey.desc: Honey does not go off. Somebody kept bees out here once.

rag.name: Torn rag
rag.desc: A strip of somebody's shirt. It will stop the bleeding. It will not keep it clean.

bandage.name: Bandage
bandage.desc: A clean roll of gauze, still in the paper.

painkillers.name: Painkillers
painkillers.desc: A brown bottle with eight pills rattling in it. Takes the edge off; does not take the bullet out.

antibiotics.name: Antibiotics
antibiotics.desc: A blister pack, a course for one. Worth more than the gun you'd trade for it.

suture_kit.name: Suture kit
suture_kit.desc: Curved needle, thread, a little bottle of iodine. Sit still.

first_aid.name: First-aid kit
first_aid.desc: A red tin box with most of what it should have in it. Three proper patch-ups.

knife.name: Folding knife
knife.desc: A lock-back with a chipped edge. Opens tins, cuts cloth.

can_opener.name: Can opener
can_opener.desc: The little army kind that lives on a keyring.

lockpicks.name: Lockpicks
lockpicks.desc: A roll of picks and a tension wrench. Quiet. Each lock costs you a pick or two.

hacksaw.name: Hacksaw
hacksaw.desc: A bow saw for metal and a spare blade. Slow work, and nobody hears it.

crowbar.name: Crowbar
crowbar.desc: Forged steel, the paint worn off the end that does the work. Opens what keys don't. Loudly.

bolt_cutters.name: Bolt cutters
bolt_cutters.desc: Two-foot jaws on long handles. A padlock's shackle or a run of chain-link, quietly.

sledgehammer.name: Sledgehammer
sledgehammer.desc: Ten pounds on a hickory handle. Any door, any lock, and everyone for a block hears it.

hammer_nails.name: Hammer and nails
hammer_nails.desc: A claw hammer and a coffee tin of bent nails. Boards go up, boards come down.

ladder_portable.name: Aluminium ladder
ladder_portable.desc: A folding ladder, sixteen feet open. Set it against a wall and the roof is yours.

door_key.name: Door key
door_key.desc: A brass key on a split ring. Somebody's door, somewhere near.

scrap_note.name: Folded note
scrap_note.desc: A page torn from a pad, folded small. Whoever dropped it was in a hurry.

radio_portable.name: Portable radio
radio_portable.desc: A battered transistor set with a bent aerial. Comma and period walk the dial.

wrench.name: Wrench
wrench.desc: An adjustable wrench. Any repair goes faster with one.

machete.name: Machete
machete.desc: A cane knife with a taped grip. Opens tins, cuts brush, settles arguments.

fire_axe.name: Fire axe
fire_axe.desc: A red-handled axe off a firehouse wall. Takes a locked door off its hinges, loudly.

flare.name: Road flare
flare.desc: A red flare in a paper tube. Strike it and put it down: a minute of fire nothing with sense walks into.

duct_tape.name: Duct tape
duct_tape.desc: Half a roll. Holds a radiator, a tank, a cracked hose until it doesn't.

fuel_can.name: Fuel can
fuel_can.desc: Ten litres of gasoline that smells like it has been through a few cans. Pour it into anything that runs.

siphon_hose.name: Siphon hose
siphon_hose.desc: Three metres of fuel line and a hand bulb. Down a station's fill pipe, the dregs come up into your car or your cans.

spare_tyre.name: Spare tyre
spare_tyre.desc: A spare on a rim, more patches than tread. Swaps for a flat.

scrap.name: Scrap steel
scrap.desc: Sheet steel, a bent hubcap, a length of rebar. A mechanic can make plate out of it.

spark_plugs.name: Spark plugs
spark_plugs.desc: A set of four, wrapped in an oily rag. A misfiring engine wants these.

bedroll.name: Bedroll
bedroll.desc: A rolled blanket and a sheet of foam, tied with cord. Better than the ground; not much better.

satchel.name: Satchel
satchel.desc: A canvas bag on a strap. Room for a few days of water and food.

backpack.name: Backpack
backpack.desc: A school pack, the zip mended with wire. Twenty-odd litres.

ruck.name: Frame ruck
ruck.desc: An army ruck on an alloy frame. Carries like a mule; you will feel every kilo of it.

ammo_pistol.name: Pistol rounds (.45 ACP)
ammo_pistol.desc: Big, slow revolver rounds, loose in a paper box gone soft at the corners.

ammo_smg.name: SMG rounds (9mm)
ammo_smg.desc: Small, fast rounds for a submachine gun. Some are reloads; you can tell by the dents.

ammo_shells.name: Shotgun shells (12 gauge buck)
ammo_shells.desc: Twelve-gauge buckshot in faded red hulls. Bulky; every one counts.

ammo_birdshot.name: Birdshot shells
ammo_birdshot.desc: Green hulls of fine lead shot for ducks and doves. Peppers a man; stops a dog.

ammo_slug.name: Slug shells
ammo_slug.desc: Black hulls, each with one soft lead slug the size of your thumb. Goes through a car door.

ammo_rifle.name: Rifle rounds (5.56)
ammo_rifle.desc: Long brass rounds on stripper clips, the old government's issue.

ammo_22lr.name: .22 rounds
ammo_22lr.desc: A brick of five hundred little rimfire rounds. Every farmhouse had one in a drawer.

ammo_357mag.name: .357 Magnum rounds
ammo_357mag.desc: Long-cased revolver rounds with soft lead noses. Loud, and they go where you point them.

ammo_762x39.name: 7.62x39 rounds
ammo_762x39.desc: Short fat rounds in grey-green lacquered steel cases, a surplus spam can of them.

ammo_762x51.name: .308 rounds (7.62x51)
ammo_762x51.desc: Full-power rifle rounds, some still on their links. The battle rifle and the medium gun eat them.

ammo_50bmg.name: .50 rounds (12.7mm)
ammo_50bmg.desc: Each one as long as your hand and heavy as a full can of beans. Made to stop trucks.

gun_pistol.name: .45 revolver
gun_pistol.desc: A six-shot revolver, the bluing worn to grey where a hand has held it for twenty years.

gun_smg.name: Rust-9 SMG
gun_smg.desc: A stamped-steel submachine gun from a backyard shop. Eats rounds; jams when it is dirty.

gun_shotgun.name: Sawn-off
gun_shotgun.desc: A double barrel cut down to the forestock with a hacksaw. Two shots, then a long minute.

gun_rifle.name: Service rifle
gun_rifle.desc: The Federal Remnant's issue rifle, serial filed off. Reaches further than anything else out here.

gun_auto.name: Self-loader
gun_auto.desc: A twelve-round semi-automatic pistol in the small, fast calibre the SMGs eat. Quick to hand, quick to empty.

gun_pump.name: Pump shotgun
gun_pump.desc: A full-length pump gun with five in the tube. Slower to fire than the sawn-off, slower to run dry.

gun_rimfire.name: .22 rifle
gun_rimfire.desc: A tube-fed .22 with a scratched walnut stock. Kept the crows off the corn; now it keeps worse off.

gun_magnum.name: .357 Magnum
gun_magnum.desc: A heavy-framed six-shot revolver. The rounds crack and the muzzle jumps.

gun_carbine.name: Surplus carbine
gun_carbine.desc: A stamped-steel carbine with a curved thirty-round magazine. Rattles when you run; fires when it is filthy.

gun_battle.name: Battle rifle
gun_battle.desc: A long, heavy rifle in .308, twenty to a magazine. Every shot shoves your shoulder back.

gun_lmg.name: Light machine gun
gun_lmg.desc: A 5.56 machine gun with a hundred-round box under it and a bipod folded flat.

gun_mmg.name: Medium machine gun
gun_mmg.desc: A belt-fed .308 gun built for a tripod or a cradle. You can carry it. You will not enjoy it.

gun_amr.name: Anti-materiel rifle
gun_amr.desc: A .50 rifle as long as a man, with a muzzle brake like a fist. It stops engines.

cleaning_kit.name: Gun cleaning kit
cleaning_kit.desc: A rod, brushes, patches and a little can of oil. Takes the grit out of whatever you are holding.

wristwatch.name: Wristwatch
wristwatch.desc: It still ticks. Somebody wound it every morning until they didn't.

gold_ring.name: Gold ring
gold_ring.desc: Somebody's promise. Worth more than a promise now.

silverware.name: Silverware
silverware.desc: A fork and two spoons, real silver. Traders weigh it.

road_atlas.name: Road atlas
road_atlas.desc: A spiral-bound atlas of the old states, the borders inked over in three colours of pen.

photograph.name: Photograph
photograph.desc: A family on a porch, squinting into the sun. Nobody you know.

dog_collar.name: Dog collar
dog_collar.desc: A worn leather collar with a name scratched into the buckle. You know the name.

tin_star.name: Deputy's star
tin_star.desc: Pressed tin, the points filed round, RUST HAVEN stamped in a ring. Okonkwo pins one on the people who keep her peace.

gator_meat.name: Gator tail meat
gator_meat.desc: White, tough, tastes like the swamp it came out of. Cook it today: in this heat it turns by tomorrow.

gator_hide.name: Gator hide
gator_hide.desc: A belly hide, scraped and salted. Traders in Meridian pay for these: boots, belts, holsters.

canteen.name: Steel canteen

gator_meat.desc: White, tough, tastes like the swamp it came out of. Cook it today: in this heat it turns by tomorrow.

gator_hide.name: Gator hide
gator_hide.desc: A belly hide, scraped and salted. Traders in Meridian pay for these: boots, belts, holsters.

baseball_bat.name: Baseball bat
baseball_bat.desc: Ash, taped at the handle, the barrel dented from something that wasn't a ball.

brass_knuckles.name: Brass knuckles
brass_knuckles.desc: Four rings of cast brass. Every punch lands like a hammer.

lead_pipe.name: Lead pipe
lead_pipe.desc: A length of old plumbing, heavy at one end where the joint is still on.

sword_cane.name: Silver-topped cane
sword_cane.desc: A black walking cane under a worn silver knob. Hold your swing and the knob twists free: a slim blade comes out of the shaft with it.

jungle_blade.name: Broad jungle blade
jungle_blade.desc: A heavy single-edged blade, broad and weighted toward the tip, the grip wrapped in old cord. Made to take a sapling in one cut.

leather_vest.name: Leather vest
leather_vest.desc: Two layers of cowhide stitched with wire. It turns a knife more often than a round.

scrap_vest.name: Scrap-plate vest
scrap_vest.desc: Hubcaps and sheet steel riveted to a canvas vest. Loud, heavy, better than skin.

soft_vest.name: Soft armor vest
soft_vest.desc: Woven ballistic panels in a faded carrier. Stops a pistol round; argues with a rifle.

service_armor.name: Service body armor
service_armor.desc: Plate carrier with ceramic inserts, old government issue. The best thing a soldier ever left behind.

composite_shell.name: Composite shell
composite_shell.desc: A moulded composite torso shell from a lab nobody comes back from. Light for what it stops.

leather_cap.name: Leather cap
leather_cap.desc: A flying cap gone soft with sweat. It keeps the sun off and a little else.

riot_helmet.name: Riot helmet
riot_helmet.desc: A police riot lid with the visor snapped off. Built for bottles, good for worse.

combat_helmet.name: Combat helmet
combat_helmet.desc: A steel-and-resin helmet with the chinstrap mended in paracord.

armored_collar.name: Armored collar
armored_collar.desc: A padded collar with a ballistic insert. Where the artery runs, a little helps a lot.

arm_guards.name: Arm guards
arm_guards.desc: Hard plastic forearm guards off a riot kit, strapped over the sleeves.

work_gloves.name: Combat gloves
work_gloves.desc: Knuckle-padded gloves. Glass, wire and teeth go through less of you.

padded_leggings.name: Padded leggings
padded_leggings.desc: Quilted trousers with shin and knee pads sewn in. The dead bite low.

plate_leggings.name: Plate leggings
plate_leggings.desc: Thigh and shin plates on straps. You walk like a door, and nothing gets your legs.

flex_base.name: Flex armor base
flex_base.desc: A stretch base layer with cut-resistant weave. Worn under everything.

trauma_insert.name: Trauma plate insert
trauma_insert.desc: A steel plate in an undershirt pocket over the heart. It has a dent in it already.

leather_duster.name: Leather duster
leather_duster.desc: A long riding coat the colour of the road. Breaks your outline at a distance.

brush_poncho.name: Brush poncho
brush_poncho.desc: Burlap strips and dead brush sewn onto netting. Lie still in it and you are scrub.

combat_boots.name: Combat boots
combat_boots.desc: Broken-in boots that fit. Out here that is worth more than a gun.

trail_boots.name: Trail runners
trail_boots.desc: Light boots with a lugged sole. Every step a little longer, a little quicker.

utility_belt.name: Utility belt
utility_belt.desc: Pouches and loops on webbing. Weight on the hips is weight off the shoulders.

rig_belt.name: Rig belt
rig_belt.desc: A padded war belt with a harness. Carries like a second pack.

ammo_bandolier.name: Ammo bandolier
ammo_bandolier.desc: Loops for rounds across the chest. The next reload is already in your hand.

double_bandolier.name: Double bandolier
double_bandolier.desc: Two belts crossed over the chest. You can reload in your sleep.

dust_mask.name: Dust mask
dust_mask.desc: A rubber mask with two filters. Seals the face slot; the filters do nothing for the air yet.

knuckle_ring.name: Knuckle ring
knuckle_ring.desc: A heavy steel ring with a ridge on it. It does not come off easily, and neither do teeth it meets.

mechanic_wraps.name: Mechanic wraps
mechanic_wraps.desc: Leather wrist wraps with a feeler gauge and a pick tucked in. Your patches hold better.

data_cuff.name: Data cuff
data_cuff.desc: A wrist computer from before the split, still loaded with service manuals. It knows every engine.

rabbit_foot.name: Lucky foot
rabbit_foot.desc: A dried rabbit's foot on a cord. Your eye catches what others miss. Probably.

scav_compass.name: Scavver's compass
scav_compass.desc: A brass compass with a needle that never points north. It points at things worth taking.

wool_coat.name: Wool coat
wool_coat.desc: Heavy grey wool, a button gone. It is the difference between a cold night and a long one.

parka.name: Insulated parka
parka.desc: A hooded parka stuffed with something that still holds heat. Smells of smoke and diesel.

knit_cap.name: Knit cap
knit_cap.desc: A wool cap pulled to the eyebrows. Most of the heat goes out the top.

insulated_boots.name: Insulated boots
insulated_boots.desc: Boots with a felt liner. Dry feet are most of winter.

road_chain.name: Road chain
road_chain.desc: Fifteen feet of tow chain wrapped with welded spikes. Swing it across a lane and it eats tyres.

spike_strip.name: Spike strip
spike_strip.desc: An accordion of hollow teeth on a plastic spine. Unfolds across a lane in one throw.

car_mine.name: Car mine
car_mine.desc: A pressure plate on a cake tin of explosive. Bury it where the wheels go, or load it in a mine dropper. Do not step on it either.

fan_mine.name: Fan mine
fan_mine.desc: A curved box of ball bearings on scissor legs. FRONT TOWARD THE ROAD, it says, in our own stencil.

crawler_mine.name: Crawler mine
crawler_mine.desc: A charge on six scrap legs and a cheap eye. Set it down; it walks to the nearest thing that hates you and sits on it.

noise_maker.name: Noise box
noise_maker.desc: A wind-up clacker in a tin. Twenty seconds of racket that every dead thing in a block walks toward.

bottle_lure.name: Bottle
bottle_lure.desc: An empty bottle. Throw it where you want them to look.

signal_flare.name: Signal flare
signal_flare.desc: A long-burning red flare. Lights a street at night; every eye and every dead thing turns to it.

smoke_canister.name: Smoke canister
smoke_canister.desc: A fat grey can. A street of smoke for half a minute: nobody sees through it, you included.

gas_can.name: Choke gas
gas_can.desc: A banded can of something that burns the eyes and the throat. People in it cough, stumble and shoot wide.

remote_charge.name: Remote charge
remote_charge.desc: A brick of charge taped round a radio receiver. Set it, walk away, press the button.

breach_charge.name: Breach charge
breach_charge.desc: A frame of cord charge you press to a door. Three seconds, then it is not a door.

car_alarm.name: Car alarm
car_alarm.desc: A siren and a motion box off a dead sedan, wired to a battery. Stick it in a car you want to come back to.

tripwire_bells.name: Tripwire bells
tripwire_bells.desc: Fishing line and a string of tin bells. Strung across a door or a gap, it tells you who came.

drone_scout.name: Scout drone
drone_scout.desc: Four rotors, a cracked camera, a battery that remembers better days. It sees what you cannot and tells on them.

drone_bomber.name: Drop drone
drone_bomber.desc: A heavier frame with a claw under it that lets go of three pipe charges. Loud. Slow. Worth it.

key_ring.name: Bull's key ring
key_ring.desc: A security man's ring of keys. Opens and locks the town's doors, quietly.

planks.name: Planks
planks.desc: Three lengths of board and a fistful of nails. Enough to bar one door.

door_wedge.name: Door wedge
door_wedge.desc: A rubber wedge. Kicked under a door it holds against a shove, not against a boot.

nvg.name: Night goggles
nvg.desc: Two night tubes off a dead tank, epoxied into a welding mask. Green, grainy, priceless. A flare in your face and you see nothing for a while.

thermal_scope.name: Heat scope
thermal_scope.desc: A pre-war heat camera in a box of foam and electrical tape. People glow white. The dead do not glow at all.

binoculars.name: Binoculars
binoculars.desc: Field glasses with one cracked lens and a bootlace strap. Scouting is how you live: nobody out there cheats.

rifle_scope.name: Rifle scope
rifle_scope.desc: A hunting scope off a deer rifle, the crosshair hairline crooked. Narrow, long, honest.

flashlight.name: Flashlight
flashlight.desc: A steel torch with a cracked lens held in with tape. It shows you the street, and shows the street you.

headlamp.name: Headlamp
headlamp.desc: A miner's lamp on a sweatband. Both hands free; it points where you look, and so does everyone who sees it.

radio_scanner.name: Radio scanner
radio_scanner.desc: A police scanner with a coat-hanger aerial. It hears the convoys talk and the bulls dispatch. It only hears what somebody actually says.

gas_mask.name: Gas mask
gas_mask.desc: A cracked rubber mask with one good eyepiece and a filter thread wrapped in tape. Smoke, chemicals, the dead air down the drains.

battery_cell.name: Battery cell
battery_cell.desc: A fat dry cell, its label sun-bleached white. Maybe half a charge. Everything worth carrying runs on these.

mask_filter.name: Mask filter
mask_filter.desc: A screw-on charcoal canister, the seal still in its foil. Five minutes of air you can trust.

dog_vest.name: Dog vest
dog_vest.desc: A cut-down flak vest laced round a dog's chest with paracord. Turns a knife and most of a bite.

dog_lamp.name: Dog lamp
dog_lamp.desc: A bike lamp zip-tied to a collar. Where the dog goes, the ground lights up.

bark_collar.name: Bark collar
bark_collar.desc: A training collar rewired to a buzzer you carry. When the dog smells trouble, you know where.

gun_percussion.name: Percussion revolver
gun_percussion.desc: A long-barrelled cap-and-ball revolver, nine chambers round a second, fatter barrel slung under the first. Flip the hammer's nose down and it fires that one: a load of shot.

ammo_capball.name: Ball, powder and caps
ammo_capball.desc: Soft lead balls, a flask of black powder, a tin of percussion caps and a bag of shot. Loads the cylinder and the barrel under it alike. Slowly.

lapel_counter.name: Lapel counter
lapel_counter.desc: A clip-on counter the size of a matchbox. Carry it and it ticks near hot ground, long before you feel it: faster the nearer, faster the hotter.

heater_meal.name: Self-heating meal
heater_meal.desc: A sealed meal pouch in a heater bag. Pull the tab and it hisses and warms with no flame; give it half a minute.

hot_meal.name: Hot meal pouch
hot_meal.desc: Steaming in its bag. Beef and beans, or something that was. Eat it while it is hot.

cloth_scrap.name: Cloth scrap
cloth_scrap.desc: A piece of curtain, a sleeve, a bedsheet gone grey. Rags, bandage and rope all start here.

wood_scrap.name: Salvage timber
wood_scrap.desc: A broken chair, a fence rail, a joist off a roof. Dry enough to work, or to burn.

nails.name: Nails
nails.desc: Loose nails in a coffee tin, a few of them straight.

charcoal.name: Charcoal
charcoal.desc: Wood burnt slow under turf. Burns hot enough to soften steel.

plant_fibre.name: Plant fibre
plant_fibre.desc: Yucca leaf and cattail stripped long. Twist it and it holds.

tallow.name: Tallow
tallow.desc: Rendered fat in a lump. Burns, waterproofs, greases.

lead_shot.name: Cast lead
lead_shot.desc: A pinch of cast slugs, melted down from pipe and fishing weights.

brass_case.name: Spent brass
brass_case.desc: Fired cases, picked up after somebody else's fight. Good for one more load.

gunpowder.name: Gunpowder
gunpowder.desc: A twist of black grain. Enough for eight loads; not for a flame nearby.

primer.name: Primers
primer.desc: Tiny brass cups of impact paste. Without one a round is a lump.

oil_flask.name: Lamp oil
oil_flask.desc: A flask of rendered oil, clear enough to burn without smoke.

herbs.name: Dried herbs
herbs.desc: Yarrow, sage and creosote, bundled in string. A medic's pantry.

camp_stew.name: Camp stew
camp_stew.desc: Beans and jerky simmered in a can. Hot, salty, and the first thing that tastes like a place.

hardtack.name: Hardtack
hardtack.desc: Flatbread baked twice until it keeps. Break a tooth, not a fast.

cactus_jam.name: Cactus jam
cactus_jam.desc: Prickly pear boiled down in its own juice. Lasts, and it is sweet.

poultice.name: Herbal poultice
poultice.desc: Crushed yarrow bound in cloth. Closes a cut and keeps the rot out of it, mostly.

tincture.name: Herb tincture
tincture.desc: Creosote and sage steeped in rotgut. Bitter. Eases a hand that shakes.

bowstring.name: Bowstring
bowstring.desc: Waxed cord, three strands. (Stub: needs a bow.)

fish_hook.name: Fish hooks
fish_hook.desc: Bent wire, filed to a barb.

cord.name: Cord
cord.desc: Twisted fibre, a few metres. Ties anything that stays still.

rope.name: Rope
rope.desc: Ten metres of three-strand rope. Holds a man, or a door.

splint.name: Splint
splint.desc: Two flat boards and cord. Sets a bad ankle so you can walk on it.

plank_barricade.name: Plank barricade
plank_barricade.desc: Cross-braced boards, ready to nail across a door or a window.

metal_barricade.name: Plate barricade
metal_barricade.desc: Two sheets of scrap steel riveted to a frame. Stops a shoulder and slows a bullet.

hammer.name: Hammer
hammer.desc: A claw hammer with a taped handle.

hand_saw.name: Hand saw
hand_saw.desc: A wood saw with a few teeth missing.

metal_file.name: Metal file
metal_file.desc: A flat file, bright where it works.

whetstone.name: Whetstone
whetstone.desc: A grey stone worn into a shallow dish by edges.

needle_kit.name: Needle and thread
needle_kit.desc: Three needles in a wad of felt, and thread of every colour.

pliers.name: Pliers
pliers.desc: Long-nosed pliers; the jaws still meet.

hatchet.name: Hatchet
hatchet.desc: A short axe, head wedged tight in a new handle. Chops wood and settles disputes.

spear.name: Spear
spear.desc: A pole with a steel point lashed on. Longer than a knife, cheaper than a gun.

repair_kit.name: Repair kit
repair_kit.desc: Patches, thread, rivets and glue in a tin. Four patch-ups for what you wear.

candle.name: Candle
candle.desc: A tallow dip on a cord wick. Lights a corner and nothing more.

torch.name: Torch
torch.desc: A stick wrapped in oiled cloth. Smoky; the dark keeps its distance.

oil_lamp.name: Oil lamp
oil_lamp.desc: A jar, a wick and a cork. A warm yellow light.

trap_trigger.name: Trap trigger
trap_trigger.desc: A notched peg and a spring of wire. Half a snare.

bow_stave.name: Bow stave
bow_stave.desc: A seasoned length of bent wood, not strung. (Stub: bows are not in the arms yet.)

arrow_shaft.name: Arrow shaft
arrow_shaft.desc: A straight shaft fletched with feathers. (Stub: needs a bow.)

workbench.name: Workbench
workbench.desc: A heavy plank table with a vise. Furniture: it lives where you set it down.

forge_kit.name: Anvil and forge
forge_kit.desc: A block of steel and a coal-bed bellows in a tub. Heavy; it needs a place.

sewing_table.name: Sewing table
sewing_table.desc: A folding table with a treadle machine bolted on.

camp_stove.name: Camp stove
camp_stove.desc: A two-ring stove on a bottle of gas. Cooks anywhere.

reload_press.name: Reloading press
reload_press.desc: A cast press with dies and a scale. Brass, powder, primer and lead go in; rounds come out.

chem_set.name: Chem set
chem_set.desc: Flasks, a spirit lamp and a rack of tubes in a wooden case.

tool_roll.name: Tool roll
tool_roll.desc: A canvas roll of the small tools. Lets you do the simple jobs from a car's trunk.

manual_gunsmith.name: Gunsmith's notebook
manual_gunsmith.desc: A grease-stained notebook of loads and charges. Written by somebody who still had all their fingers.

manual_smith.name: Smith's primer
manual_smith.desc: A water-stained trade pamphlet: heats, quenches and the colour of good steel.

manual_field_medicine.name: Field medicine card
manual_field_medicine.desc: A laminated card in a stranger's hand: what to boil, what to bind, what to leave alone.
